output_add.title: Choose output type and target
output_add.description: Switch outputs need a switch, light or siren entity. Text targets are optional: without a target only the local status entity updates. The next step prefills the name.

output_details.description: Set values for each alarm phase. Enabled, assigned targets are actually switched or written.

status.title: Status & overview

error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
error.invalid_state: Use 1 to 255 characters; unknown and unavailable are not trigger states.
error.entity_not_found: This entity does not exist. Select an existing entity.
error.own_entity: This integration's own sensors cannot be input sources.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm removal or cancel the dialog.
error.choose_inputs: Select at least one input without duplicates.
error.unknown_input: A selected input no longer exists. Check the selection.
error.input_in_use: This input is still used by rules. Edit or remove those rules first.
error.invalid_output_target: Target entity does not match the output type.
error.output_target_required: Select a target entity for a switch output.
error.duplicate_output_target: An output for this target already exists. Share that output between rules or edit it.
error.invalid_template: Use only the listed simple placeholders; check braces and spelling.
error.text_too_long: Use at most 4096 characters and no null characters.
error.short_text_invalid: Enter short text without line breaks.
error.short_text_too_long: Short text exceeds 14 bytes. Shorten it; rendered placeholders are checked at runtime too.
error.unsupported_character: Text contains characters outside the chosen encoding.
error.output_in_use: This output is still assigned to rules. Remove those assignments first.
error.output_owned: This target is still controlled by the integration. Reset the alarm or disable the output and wait for the idle value to be confirmed.

abort.invalid_configuration: Inputs, rules or outputs are invalid or from a newer version. Nothing was overwritten; check logs and backup.
abort.configuration_changed: Configuration changed while this dialog was open. Please reopen it.
abort.max_inputs: Maximum of ten inputs. Remove an input first.
abort.no_inputs_for_rules: First add at least one input under Input sources.
abort.max_rules: Maximum of 30 rules. Remove a rule first.
abort.no_rules: No rules yet. Add a rule to begin.
abort.max_outputs: Maximum of 20 outputs. Remove one first.
